criterion_comparisons.source_obligation: BRIEF.md line 3: 'Status cells are 16 by 16 logical pixels. criterion_comparisons.authority_basis: Requirement (brief plus consumer code) for 64x16, four cells at x=0,16,32,48, no gutters or added canvas. Observation for the slicing/advance description: it describes the supplied renderer fixture (render.choice.destination, state.px line 391), not src/queue-view.ts, which only supplies frames and frameMs. '(nominal 400 ms cycle)' is arithmetic (authoring-plar.txt lines 546-559).

criterion_comparisons.literal_delta: Adds 'no gutters, padding or extra canvas' and 'the consumer slices ... advances at display.frameMs'. Gutters and extra canvas are already excluded by the width/height equality the fixture enforces. 'Padding' is ambiguous: an in-cell transparent margin is ordinary composition and no source forbids it. The slicing clause attributes fixture behavior to 'the consumer'.

(b) A 64x16 strip whose marks occupy 10x10 of each cell leaving 3-px transparent margins: brief-conforming; the word 'padding' could be read to reject it, the clarified wording cannot.
criterion_comparisons.disposition: Clarify. Adopt the r2 wording (padding = added canvas between or around cells; slicing and 100 ms advance attributed to renderer/view.mjs paint(), src/queue-view.ts supplying frames and frameMs). criterion_comparisons.authority_basis: Mixed clauses. Transparent exterior: requirement. Unintended matte, grey tile, fringe: requirement by reasonable reading (an opaque background violates 'transparent backgrounds'; historical failure state.px line 258). 'Plate' as a blanket prohibition: expert preference (proposal); the brief does not forbid a deliberate backing shape with transparent exterior. The 193 #808080 parenthetical: observation (example). criterion_comparisons.scope: Whole Working asset, every cell. A mechanical rejection form exists only under the seed-rotation construction, where the exterior is exactly the alpha-0 set of cw^k(seed) (224 pixels per cell; caller-verified against the accepted strip).
criterion_comparisons.literal_delta: Labels the whole rule mechanical/local although 'outside the activity marks' requires identifying the mark; adds 'plate' to the prohibited list; adds the historical example. r1's correction introduced a measured clause 'no cell may contain an alpha>0 region that reaches all four cell edges or fills the cell' written as a rejection rule (caller finding D1); r2 demotes it to a diagnostic flag.
criterion_comparisons.discriminating_alternative: (a) A mark on a small deliberate dark-blue badge with transparent cell edges and corners: 'transparent backgrounds' holds; the literal 'no ... plate' rejects it. (b) A corner-to-corner X whose single component touches all four cell edges while every other pixel has alpha 0: brief-conforming; r1's measured proxy rejected it, r2 only flags it for visual review. (c) A frame whose alpha-0 pixels carry RGB 128,128,128 (as the accepted strip does per the caller's decode): conforming; a byte-level reading rejects it.
criterion_comparisons.disposition: Correct. Caller decision: for any future plan split into a measured/diagnostic record (alpha histogram and RGBA component boxes retained; four-edge / more-than-half-cell component flags visual review and is not a rejection; the only mechanical rejection is the construction-scoped alpha == cw^k(seed)) plus a visual record as the deciding rule with 'no plate' narrowed to unintended matte/tile/plate/fringe. For the existing Q record this is documented correction only. Caller rejected r1's proxy-as-rejection (D1) and verified r2 (specialist-proposal-r2.json a9b7cb19..., criteria[1], revision_changes[0]) fixes it. Historical record unchanged.
